records.quote: The complementry event :
If A ⊂ S then A` is the complementary event to event A
records.claim: If A ⊂ S then A` is the complementary event to event A, where A ∪ A` = S and A ∩ A` = φ.

records.quote: the event and the complementary event are two mutually exclusive events
records.claim: The event and the complementary event are two mutually exclusive events.

records.label: Example
records.quote: A classroom contains 40 students. 18 of them read Al-Akhbar newspaper
records.stem: A classroom contains 40 students. 18 of them read Al-Akhbar newspaper, 15 read Al Ahram news paper and 8 read both newspapers. If a student is selected randomly calculate the probability that the student:
solution: Let the event A be reading Al Akhbar newspaper and the event B reading Al Ahram newspaper. then A ∩ B is the event of reading both newspapers.
A: event A: Read Al Akhbar newspaper then $P(A)=\frac{n(A)}{n(S)}=\frac{18}{40}=\frac{9}{20}$
B: Does not read Al Akhbar is the complementary event of the event A and it is A`. $\therefore P(A')=\frac{\text{number of elements of s set }A'}{n(S)}=\frac{15+7}{40}=\frac{22}{40}=\frac{11}{20}$
C: event B: read Al Ahram newspaper then: $P(B)=\frac{n(B)}{n(S)}=\frac{15}{40}=\frac{3}{8}$
D: event A ∩ B means reading both newspaper. $\therefore P(A\cap B)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(S)}=\frac{8}{40}=\frac{1}{5}$
records.notes: Venn diagram k4 is part of the solution. The printed Venn labels and values may conflict with the text (see k4). Part B printed 15+7 as set A' count.

objectives.label: Find the complementary event
objectives.description: Find the complementary event A' of an event A in a sample space, using the Venn diagram and the facts A ∪ A' = S and A ∩ A' = φ.

objectives.label: Use P(A') = 1 - P(A)
objectives.description: Use P(A) + P(A') = 1 to find the probability of an event or of its complement.

objectives.label: Represent the difference between two events
objectives.description: Represent the difference A - B on a Venn diagram and explain it as the occurrence of A only, not B.

objectives.label: Calculate probabilities from a two-event Venn diagram
objectives.description: Calculate probabilities of events such as reading one paper, both, or one only, using the Venn diagram.
